mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing mainly clear skies with a pleasant temperature of 74 degrees near the Verona Public Library. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase.

There are a couple of important updates from City Hall. First, the Department of Public Works is seeking an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects, with applications open until September 20. Additionally, the city has launched a rain barrel rebate program offering thirty dollars back for qualifying installations, and new utility rate structures are now in effect to support necessary sewer and stormwater maintenance.

It is a busy week for our community. We have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company taking place today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmer's Market at the Capitol Square or catch more live music at Paddy Mac's.

In a noteworthy call from our weekly report, on Friday, officers arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive in her vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
Today's featured flavor is the decadent Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
